messages.text: Could you make three different logo options for my cycling club? I’m excited to see some ideas because I’ve been having trouble picturing what would feel right for the club. The name is Moss & Mile, and each option should include that exact wording, including the ampersand, with no extra text, plus a small symbol. I’d like three separate square images at 640 × 640 px each, not a collage or contact sheet. Please keep the logos simple, using green and black on white. The symbols and fonts are your call, but I do mean three genuinely different symbol or layout concepts rather than just recolors of the same design.

style.prompt: Simple flat vector logo on a plain white background. A small minimalist bicycle icon whose two wheels are drawn as round moss-green circles, black frame, centered above the text. Below it the words "Moss & Mile" in a bold black geometric sans-serif font, spelled exactly with the ampersand. Only green and black on white. No other text, no tagline, no border, single logo only.

Simple flat vector badge logo on a plain white background. A circular emblem with a thin black ring; inside it a small green moss leaf with a winding road running through it like a leaf vein. Underneath the emblem the words "Moss & Mile" in an elegant black serif font, spelled exactly with the ampersand. Only green and black on white. No other text, no tagline, single logo only.

Simple flat vector horizontal wordmark logo on a plain white background. On the left a small green mountain peak icon with a black winding road line curving up it. To the right of the icon, on one line, the words "Moss & Mile" in a black italic hand-lettered script font, spelled exactly with the ampersand. Only green and black on white. No other text, no tagline, single logo only.
